MWCapture SDKv3 Software Development Library

Magewell SDKv3 defines library functions and a set of data structures, including Macros, Color Format, Enumration Types, Structures and Callback Functions. These data structures and library functions enable you to flexibly and efficiently incorporate support for the powerful features of our capture cards into your applications for your users to easily take advantage of.

Color Format

Color Format is a four-character code defined by a macro that represents the format of the video stream. The Color Format chapter lists all video streaming formats and related functions supported by our various capture device families.

Library Function

SDKv3 is compatible with our Pro Capture, Eco Capture, USB Capture Gen2 and USB Capture Plus family devices. But available functions vary depending on the hardware configuration, firmware version, driver and product family of the capture card. For detailed information, please refer to MWCAP_PRODUCT_ID.

Library functions are categorized by the compatibility of the capture devices as follows:

  1. MWCapture SDKv3 Universal Functions
  2. MWCapture SDKv3 Pro/Eco Capture Family Universal Functions
  3. MWCapture SDKv3 Pro Capture Functions
  4. MWCapture SDKv3 Eco Capture Functions
  5. MWCapture SDKv3 USB Family Functions

Latest Features

Get new features to make Magewell capture cards work better for you.

  1. MP4
  2. Closed Caption
  3. HDR
  4. GPU Hardware Encoding
